objective: Run sql/tests/TESTS.sql end to end for the first time against a local Supabase stack (supabase CLI 2.120.0, Postgres 17, SCHEMA.sql + private user-icons bucket) and fix every failing block until the final rollback PASS line prints.
acceptance_criteria: Step 1 (tests): TESTS.sql passes end to end with psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 on a fresh local database built from SCHEMA.sql; each failure is classified as a test bug (fixed in TESTS.sql) or a schema/RPC bug (fixed with a re-runnable migration reflected in SCHEMA.sql); sql/README.md documents the local run procedure.
Step 2 (review): Base..Target static review, artifacts, main merge, and production migration instructions if any schema/RPC bug was fixed.
